This is an ideal developmental opportunity for a recent graduate or early-career resilience professional with a strong grounding in emergency planning theory and a willingness to learn. jobs.description:
At Trustpilot, we're on an incredible journey. We're a profitable, high-growth FTSE-250 company with a big vision: to become the universal symbol of trust. We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

As an Customer Success Manager, you support a portfolio of customers to ensure they onboard successfully, adopt Trustpilot effectively, and achieve measurable value from the platform.

You are accountable for driving strong Business Adoption and Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) within a structured, high-volume portfolio, with Net Promoter Score (NPS) tracked as a key measure of customer experience and satisfaction.

This role follows defined playbooks and processes to deliver consistent, repeatable customer success outcomes while developing your capability to manage more complex portfolios over time.

What You'll Be Doing

Onboarding & Activation: Lead post-sale onboarding and setup, ensuring a smooth handover from New Business and a strong foundation for adoption.
Adoption & Value Realization: Drive measurable Business Adoption across your customer portfolio to deliver tangible results.
Retention & Churn reduction: Achieve high Gross Renewal Rate (GRR) by maintaining customer health and addressing risks proactively.
Retention & Churn Reduction: Own customer health, proactively identifying risks and executing recovery actions to maintain high Gross Renewal Rates (GRR).
Customer Experience & NPS: Drive customer satisfaction and advocacy, achieving strong Net Promoter Score (NPS) results across your portfolio.
Customer Issue Resolution: Act as the first line for customer issues related to onboarding, usage, or product value, escalating commercial or billing matters to the Account Manager.
Customer Advocacy: Partner with Marketing to identify case study, testimonial, and reference opportunities.
Voice of the Customer: Collaborate with Product to share structured customer feedback and insights that inform roadmap improvements.
Operational Excellence: Maintain accurate health metrics, notes, and success plans in CRM for full portfolio visibility.

Who You Are

You have prior experience in customer success, account management, or customer support roles in a SaaS or technology environment.
Proven ability to drive product adoption, customer satisfaction (NPS), and retention results.
Technically confident and able to guide customers through setup, usage, and best practices.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills across multiple stakeholder levels.
Comfortable working with data and insights to identify trends, risks, and opportunities.
Highly organized with excellent follow-through and attention to detail.
Collaborative team player who enjoys working with Account Managers, Product, and Marketing to deliver customer value.
A genuine passion for helping customers succeed and seeing measurable business impact.
A good understanding of the digital advertising/search marketing industry – preferred.

What’s In It For You

A competitive base salary ranging from $65,000-77,000 gross per year plus a competitive commission structure. The base salary range stated doesn't include any variable pay such as bonuses or commission, awards made under Trustpilot's equity program, or other benefits.
A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you
20 vacation days + 2 personal days +10 paid holidays per year
Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community
Rich learning and development opportunities supported through the Trustpilot Academy, LinkedIn Learning and Blinkist
Full health insurance
401k matching your contributions dollar-for-dollar up to 4% of your base salary
24/7 Employee Assistance Plan and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health
Paid parental leave for employees who have been employed for over 6 months with full full scope of benefit after 12 months
Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities and team socials
A friendly, fun and open office complete with a gaming room and fully stocked fridge with ever changing snacks and drinks
Communal lunch, extra treats and events in the month -- think ice cream carts, coffee bars and massages, to name a few

Still not sure?

We want to be a part of creating a more diverse, equitable, and inclusive world of work for all. We’re excited to hear about your experiences as well as how you will contribute to our working culture. So, even if you don’t feel you don't meet all the requirements, we'd still really like to hear from you!

About Us

Trustpilot began in 2007 with a simple yet powerful idea that is more relevant today than ever — to be the universal symbol of trust, bringing consumers and businesses together through reviews. Trustpilot is open, independent, and impartial — we help consumers make the right choices and businesses to build trust, grow and improve.

Today, we have more than 350 million reviews and 60 million monthly active users across the globe, with 149 billion annual Trustpilot brand impressions, and the numbers keep growing. We have more than 1000 employees and we’re headquartered in Copenhagen, with operations in Amsterdam, Denver, Edinburgh, Hamburg, London, Melbourne, Milan and New York.

We’re driven by connection. It’s at the heart of what we do. Our culture keeps things fresh –– it’s built on the relationships we create. We talk, we laugh, we collaborate and we respect each other. We work across borders and cultures to be the universal symbol of trust in an ever-changing world. With vibrant office locations worldwide and over 50 nationalities, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace with diverse perspectives and ideas.

Our purpose to help people and businesses help each other is a tall order, but we keep it real. We’re a great bunch of humans, doing awesome stuff, without fuss or pretense. A successful Trustpilot future is driven by you –– we give you the autonomy to shape a career you can be proud of. If you’re ready to grow, let’s go.

Join us at the heart of trust.

Trustpilot is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Trustpilot will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status. Together, we are the heart of trust.

Customer Success Specialist
Location:
Remote, U.S. (Pacific Time Zone Preferred)

About Knomee
Knomee is building the behavioral intelligence platform for financial services.
We help financial institutions drive organic growth by understanding what clients and prospects want, what’s changing, and when they’re ready to act. Our platform combines behavioral science, AI, and thoughtful product design to help firms convert prospects, deepen relationships, grow households, and retain clients through transitions.

We're an early-stage company creating a new category. Every customer matters. Every implementation teaches us something. Every successful customer helps us build a better company.
We're looking for our first Customer Success Specialist to help customers adopt Knomee, realize value quickly, and become long-term advocates. 

The Opportunity

As Knomee's first Customer Success Specialist, you'll work directly with the CEO to ensure every customer has an exceptional experience—from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and expansion.
You'll become the primary point of contact for our customers, helping them achieve meaningful outcomes while serving as the voice of the customer inside the company. You'll identify what's working, where customers get stuck, and how we can continuously improve.

This is a hands-on, high-energy role for someone who wants to build, not inherit, a customer success playbook. You’ll be close to our customers from day one, constantly testing creative ways to increase engagement and usage. If you’re looking for established processes and predictable days, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you want significant responsibility early in your career and the chance to figure out what works, it could be.

What You'll Own
You'll own the day-to-day customer experience and help build the foundation of Knomee's customer success function.

Specifically, you will:
Lead customer onboarding and help customers get to value quickly.
Engage customers proactively at least weekly with ideas, use cases, templates, insights, and recommendations that give them reasons to use Knomee.
Own activation and usage. If engagement is low, dig into why, develop a hypothesis, try something, and measure whether it worked.
Build trusted relationships with advisors and customer stakeholders.
Learn how each customer grows and find creative ways to embed Knomee into their existing marketing, business development, advisor, and client workflows.
Own weekly customer success reporting, tracking logins, usage, invitations, completions, use cases, risks, and actions so we always know what’s working, what isn’t, and what we’re doing next.
Support pilots, renewals, and expansion opportunities.
Turn successful experiments and customer learnings into templates, best practices, and repeatable playbooks that help every customer get more value from Knomee.
Bring customer feedback and patterns back to Product and Engineering.
Jump in wherever needed to make a customer successful. At our stage, no customer task is beneath you.

How Success Is Measured
Success in this role is measured by customer outcomes—not activity. 
Your success will be reflected in:
Customer activation and time-to-value
Weekly and monthly active usage
Growth in Knomee invitations and completions
Adoption of high-value use cases
Pilot-to-contract conversion, retention, and expansion
Customer outcomes tied to growth
Your ability to turn experiments into repeatable activation playbooks

If customers aren't realizing value from Knomee, we haven't succeeded. If usage is low, your job is not simply to report it. Your job is to understand why and figure out what we can do about it.

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who enjoys working with customers, takes ownership naturally, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. In any given week, you might analyze usage data, call customers, create an engagement campaign, test a new activation idea, and report back on what worked. You won't wait for a playbook. You'll help us build it.
You likely bring:
1–4 years of professional experience, ideally in Customer Success, Account Management, Implementation, Sales, consulting, fintech, or another customer-facing role.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Comfort with data and the discipline to measure whether your work is changing customer behavior.
Strong organization and attention to detail.
Comfort communicating directly with senior customers despite being earlier in your career.
Genuine belief in what Knomee is building and enthusiasm for helping customers see its value.

Experience in wealth management, fintech, or enterprise SaaS is a very major plus.

How You Work

You are:
Hungry to learn and prove yourself.
High-energy, optimistic, and persistent.
Resourceful when there isn't an obvious answer.
Willing to do the detailed, repetitive work required to get something right.
Curious about customers and why people behave the way they do.
Someone who sees “we don't have a playbook yet” as an opportunity, not a problem.

You don't expect someone else to solve problems first. You identify what needs to happen, take initiative, and follow through.

You don't confuse a customer saying they like Knomee with customer success. Success means they are using it, getting measurable value from it, and wanting to use it more.

Growth Opportunity
This role is the foundation of Knomee's customer success function.
As the company grows, strong performance will create opportunities to take on broader ownership across customer success, enterprise implementations, account expansion, and team leadership. Growth will be based on demonstrated impact—not tenure.

Why Join Knomee
We believe the future of financial services is more human. Join us in building the behavioral intelligence layer that helps financial institutions understand people better and turn that understanding into growth.

Email careers@knomee.com with your cover letter and resume.

Customer Success Specialist
Location:
Remote, U.S. (Pacific Time Zone Preferred)

About Knomee
Knomee is building the behavioral intelligence platform for financial services.
We help financial institutions drive organic growth by understanding what clients and prospects want, what’s changing, and when they’re ready to act. Our platform combines behavioral science, AI, and thoughtful product design to help firms convert prospects, deepen relationships, grow households, and retain clients through transitions.

We're an early-stage company creating a new category. Every customer matters. Every implementation teaches us something. Every successful customer helps us build a better company.
We're looking for our first Customer Success Specialist to help customers adopt Knomee, realize value quickly, and become long-term advocates. 

The Opportunity

As Knomee's first Customer Success Specialist, you'll work directly with the CEO to ensure every customer has an exceptional experience—from onboarding through adoption, renewal, and expansion.
You'll become the primary point of contact for our customers, helping them achieve meaningful outcomes while serving as the voice of the customer inside the company. You'll identify what's working, where customers get stuck, and how we can continuously improve.

This is a hands-on, high-energy role for someone who wants to build, not inherit, a customer success playbook. You’ll be close to our customers from day one, constantly testing creative ways to increase engagement and usage. If you’re looking for established processes and predictable days, this probably isn’t the right fit. If you want significant responsibility early in your career and the chance to figure out what works, it could be.

What You'll Own
You'll own the day-to-day customer experience and help build the foundation of Knomee's customer success function.

Specifically, you will:
Lead customer onboarding and help customers get to value quickly.
Engage customers proactively at least weekly with ideas, use cases, templates, insights, and recommendations that give them reasons to use Knomee.
Own activation and usage. If engagement is low, dig into why, develop a hypothesis, try something, and measure whether it worked.
Build trusted relationships with advisors and customer stakeholders.
Learn how each customer grows and find creative ways to embed Knomee into their existing marketing, business development, advisor, and client workflows.
Own weekly customer success reporting, tracking logins, usage, invitations, completions, use cases, risks, and actions so we always know what’s working, what isn’t, and what we’re doing next.
Support pilots, renewals, and expansion opportunities.
Turn successful experiments and customer learnings into templates, best practices, and repeatable playbooks that help every customer get more value from Knomee.
Bring customer feedback and patterns back to Product and Engineering.
Jump in wherever needed to make a customer successful. At our stage, no customer task is beneath you.

How Success Is Measured
Success in this role is measured by customer outcomes—not activity. 
Your success will be reflected in:
Customer activation and time-to-value
Weekly and monthly active usage
Growth in Knomee invitations and completions
Adoption of high-value use cases
Pilot-to-contract conversion, retention, and expansion
Customer outcomes tied to growth
Your ability to turn experiments into repeatable activation playbooks

If customers aren't realizing value from Knomee, we haven't succeeded. If usage is low, your job is not simply to report it. Your job is to understand why and figure out what we can do about it.

What We're Looking For
We're looking for someone who enjoys working with customers, takes ownership naturally, and thrives in a fast-moving environment. In any given week, you might analyze usage data, call customers, create an engagement campaign, test a new activation idea, and report back on what worked. You won't wait for a playbook. You'll help us build it.
You likely bring:
1–4 years of professional experience, ideally in Customer Success, Account Management, Implementation, Sales, consulting, fintech, or another customer-facing role.
Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
Comfort with data and the discipline to measure whether your work is changing customer behavior.
Strong organization and attention to detail.
Comfort communicating directly with senior customers despite being earlier in your career.
Genuine belief in what Knomee is building and enthusiasm for helping customers see its value.

Experience in wealth management, fintech, or enterprise SaaS is a very major plus.

How You Work

You are:
Hungry to learn and prove yourself.
High-energy, optimistic, and persistent.
Resourceful when there isn't an obvious answer.
Willing to do the detailed, repetitive work required to get something right.
Curious about customers and why people behave the way they do.
Someone who sees “we don't have a playbook yet” as an opportunity, not a problem.

You don't expect someone else to solve problems first. You identify what needs to happen, take initiative, and follow through.

You don't confuse a customer saying they like Knomee with customer success. Success means they are using it, getting measurable value from it, and wanting to use it more.

Growth Opportunity
This role is the foundation of Knomee's customer success function.
As the company grows, strong performance will create opportunities to take on broader ownership across customer success, enterprise implementations, account expansion, and team leadership. Growth will be based on demonstrated impact—not tenure.

Why Join Knomee
We believe the future of financial services is more human. Join us in building the behavioral intelligence layer that helps financial institutions understand people better and turn that understanding into growth.

Email careers@knomee.com with your cover letter and resume.
